stories.headline: Interpol says global fraud operation arrested 5,811 suspects

key_facts.fact: Interpol announced on July 9 that Operation First Light 2026 led to 5,811 arrests across 97 countries and territories.
key_facts.excerpt: A global anti-fraud operation involving 97 countries and territories has led to the arrest of 5,811 individuals.

key_facts.fact: Authorities intercepted $293 million in illicit assets during the operation.
key_facts.excerpt: The operation led to the interception of USD 293 million in illicit assets.

key_facts.fact: The operation targeted social engineering scams and related money laundering from January 15 to April 30, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Operation First Light 2026 (15 Jan 2026 - 30 April 2026), coordinated by INTERPOL, focused on combatting social engineering scams and associated money laundering activities.

key_facts.fact: Interpol said more than 142,000 victims were identified globally and 31,014 bank accounts were blocked.
key_facts.excerpt: Over 142,000 victims globally were identified... Other significant results include... 31,014 bank accounts blocked.

sources.title: Over 5,800 arrests, USD 293 million intercepted in global fraud bust

stories.headline: Block agrees to $45M Cash App fraud-protection settlement

key_facts.fact: Block agreed to pay $45 million to resolve a multistate probe into Cash App fraud protections.
key_facts.excerpt: Block has agreed to pay $45 million... to settle claims... that the company failed to protect users from fraud.

key_facts.fact: The settlement covered claims brought by 46 U.S. states.
key_facts.excerpt: Block agrees to pay $45M... to settle claims by 46 US states.

key_facts.fact: The settlement also requires Cash App to offer live customer support.
key_facts.excerpt: Block agrees to pay $45M and offer live customer support for Cash App.

sources.title: Cash App parent settles states probe over fraud protections for $45 million

stories.headline: John Deere reaches FTC right-to-repair settlement

key_facts.fact: The FTC and five state attorneys general secured a right-to-repair settlement with Deere on July 8.
key_facts.excerpt: The Federal Trade Commission and attorneys general from several states secured a right-to-repair settlement Wednesday with agriculture equipment giant Deere & Co.

key_facts.fact: The order requires Deere to make diagnostic and repair tools available to owners and independent repair shops.
key_facts.excerpt: Deere will now be required to make diagnostic and repair tools available to equipment owners and independent repair shops.

key_facts.fact: The settlement bars Deere dealers from retaliating against owners or repair shops that perform independent repairs.
key_facts.excerpt: It also prevents Deere dealers from retaliating against equipment owners or repair shops who choose to fix their own equipment.

key_facts.fact: Deere must pay $1 million to five states and will face compliance oversight for 10 years.
key_facts.excerpt: Deere must pay $1 million collectively to the five states... and will be subject to strict compliance oversight for the next 10 years.

sources.title: John Deere owners will get the right to repair their own equipment under a new FTC settlement

stories.headline: Trump says US will let Ukraine manufacture Patriot air defenses

key_facts.fact: At the NATO summit in Ankara, Trump said the U.S. will give Ukraine a license to make Patriot air defense systems.
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. President Donald Trump said at a NATO summit Wednesday in Turkey that the U.S. will give Ukraine a license to make Patriot air defense systems.

key_facts.fact: AP described the move as a major boost for Kyiv as it fights Russian missile attacks.
key_facts.excerpt: President Donald Trump said the US will give a license to Ukraine to build Patriot air defense systems, a major boost for Kyiv as it battles Russia.

key_facts.fact: Trump made the announcement during a meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on the summit sidelines.
key_facts.excerpt: Trump announced the move during a meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on the sidelines of the NATO summit.

key_facts.fact: Trump also said the U.S. would work on some kind of security package for Ukraine.
key_facts.excerpt: Trump said... the U.S. would 'work on some kind of security package' to provide to Ukraine.

sources.title: Trump says US will give Ukraine license to produce Patriot defense systems

stories.headline: Oil jumps over 5% after fresh US-Iran escalation

key_facts.fact: Brent crude rose more than 5% on July 8 after attacks near the Strait of Hormuz and Trump said the Iran ceasefire was over.
key_facts.excerpt: Brent, the global crude benchmark rose by 5% on Wednesday to more than $78 a barrel.

key_facts.fact: The Guardian attributed the move to attacks on fossil-fuel tankers near the Strait of Hormuz and Trump declaring the ceasefire over.
key_facts.excerpt: Oil markets have recorded the sharpest price rise in nearly two months after a series of attacks on fossil fuel tankers near the strait of Hormuz led Donald Trump to declare that the ceasefire deal with Iran was over.

key_facts.fact: Global stock markets fell, with European and U.S. indices selling off as energy prices rose.
key_facts.excerpt: Global stock markets responded negatively: Europe's FTSE 100, DAX, and Ibex fell, as did US indices like the S&P 500 and Dow Jones.

sources.title: Oil prices jump over 5% after Trump suggests ceasefire with Iran has ended following fresh US strikes - as it happened
